markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (47%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Invasive follows at 43% [F1], and the reliability check flagged this image [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 47%, Invasive 43% | Near tie |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.75 (flagged); OOD 32% | Input flagged; use caution |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees with production classifier |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign, 3 InSitu | Weak support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest association with invasive carcinoma in concept model [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood; spot check failed [F3] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Weaker association, same regions as stroma [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Small association; concept flagged weak · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deleting the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 beyond random (CI 0.47–0.60): faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on normal lobules and mitoses (both Unreliable).

## Could be wrong if
- Image quality is suspect (reliability 0.75, flagged), so probabilities may be off.
- Invasive signal in regions 0–3 and 7 may be diluted by benign regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **0, 1, 3** — Confirm infiltrating stroma and pleomorphic nuclei; decide whether invasion is present.
2. **2, 7** — High invasive risk but not top concept regions; look for a focal invasive area.
3. **9, 10, 11** — Verify the "normal lobules"; that concept's spot check scored 0/20.
